title: Texas Manufacturer Saves Big & Keeps Its Promise — MSC Industrial Supply Co.
summary: A manufacturer of heavy-duty truck accessories needed grinding performance to match their commitment to near-zero rejection rates and unmatched durability.
body_markdown:
Deep in the Lone Star state, a premier manufacturer of heavy-duty truck accessories built their reputation on one unshakable principle: protecting families on the road.Operating two fabrication facilities, they process over 40,000 pounds of steel every day. With their commitment to near-zero rejection rates and a reputation for unmatched durability, they needed grinding performance that could match their standards.


## The Challenge


1.


**Disc Loading —** Used four discs to complete what should have taken two.


2.


**Inconsistent Quality —** Uneven scuff pattern left the finish unfinished.


3.


**Improper Approach —** Incorrect tools and techniques led to waste.


4.


**Lost Productivity —** Every minute spent troubleshooting was a minute not building.


## Weiler's Solution


Weiler introduced their new 3D MAX Ceramic Resin Fiber Disc, along with several operational improvements. They advised on the correct backing pad for optimal disc performance, enhanced process efficiencies, proper grinding techniques and provided reliable local distribution to keep them in action.


## The Impact


1.


**Unmatched Grain Retention —** Improved product lifecycle slashed abrasive spend.


2.


**Unbeatable Performance —** 3D grain technology made grinding easier and faster.


3.


**On-site Collaboration —** On-site collaboration unlocked productivity gains.


4.


**Unquestionable Results —** Delivered a more consistent finish and reduced rework.


***This article was previously featured on Weiler's***[blog](https://www.weilerabrasives.com/success-story-texas-manufacturer-achieves-massive-savings-and-superior-quality) ***.***
